text:
eli (PM): Quick sync — proposal for a segmented private-preview pilot (want feedback).

maria (Eng): high-level?

eli (PM): Target: 8 design partners, 4 regulated (finance/health) + 4 growth-stage startups. 8-week pilot, 2-week ramp, 6-week active feedback.

dan (Solutions): sounds doable. Do we have capacity for private deploy + data isolation for 4 regs?

maria (Eng): We can spin private instances but need lead time for onboarding, cert checks, and KMS configs. Estimate 3 weeks infra prep per partner if parallelized using our private helm chart.

sophia (Research): What are primary success metrics? retention? latency SLOs? qualitative quality?

eli (PM): Proposed success criteria: 1) partner uses endpoint in production path (>=50 calls/day) by week 4; 2) no P0 reliability incidents; 3) measured quality delta <= 5% vs baseline on partner prompts; 4) actionable feedback (>=15 distinct prompts + feature requests).

dan (Solutions): Need to make the ask clear in recruitment — participants should commit an engineer and a product owner to weekly check-ins.

nina (Design): Also ask for 3 annotated example flows per partner — helps us build UX fixes.

eli (PM): Agreed. Incentives: free private deployment for pilot duration + post-pilot credits + co-marketing quote. For regulated partners add optional SOC2 contract fast-track. Thoughts?

lee (Customer): as someone who’s been on earlier pilots: timeline matters. Make onboarding checklist explicit. we need an NDA + simple data handling summary up front.

eli (PM): Good point — draft onboarding checklist (snippet):

```
Onboarding checklist (pilot):
- Sign NDA + DPA
- Security intake (KMS, IP allowlist)
- Private control plane access
- Sample integration guide (sdk + curl)
- Validation run (10k tokens synthetic)
- Weekly 30m sync + biweekly health report
```

eli (PM): Recruitment email draft (very short):

"Hey <Name>, we’re running a short private preview for Redwood Private — 8 partners, focused on real production workloads. We’ll cover deployment, infra, and provide credits. Expect 8-week pilot, weekly check-ins, and a small integration effort. Interested?"


dan (Solutions): Add: "We require a technical contact and a product lead; SOC2/Compliance path available for regulated orgs."

eli (PM): Good. Feedback loops: weekly written check-in + one discovery call mid-pilot + final debrief. We’ll use a shared Notion board + SLO dashboard access.

sophia (Research): For quality measurement we should send a seed prompt suite (30 prompts) + allow partners to add 20 partner-specific prompts. Score: top-1 similarity vs baseline + qualitative rating 1-5.

maria (Eng): Also instrument token-level cost breakdown and p99 latency per route; partners will want that.

eli (PM): Rollout plan for accepted partners:
1) Week -2: Legal + security sign-off
2) Week 0: Infra deploy + access
3) Week 1: Integration + validation run
4) Weeks 2-7: Active pilot (metrics, weekly syncs)
5) Week 8: Final debrief + go/no-go decision

eli (PM): Go/no-go decision criteria: if at least 3 of 4 internal SLOs pass (uptime, p99 latency, quality delta, partner adoption) and partner indicates willingness to continue, convert to paid Dedicated contract or extended private arrangement.

nina (Design): We should create a short feedback form (10 questions) to standardize inputs across partners. I can mock tomorrow.

lee (Customer): Recommend a short "integration guide" video — partners appreciate a 5-min walkthrough.

jordan (Ops-bot): Reminder: schedule a capacity reservation on dedicated pool for pilot dates once partners confirmed.

eli (PM): Action items: nina mock feedback form (due 48h), maria produce infra prep runbook (72h), dan draft recruitment messaging + list of prospects (48h), sophia produce seed prompt suite (72h). I'll finalize incentives/legal blurb and send outreach next Tue.

maria (Eng): I’ll also add a small automation to provision test KMS keys for partners (reduces manual overhead).

dan (Solutions): I’ll prioritize 6 partners to outreach first (mix of regulated + startup).

eli (PM): One more: keep pilot cohort diverse in latency profiles (short chat vs long-doc generation). We want to see cache/batching behavior.

lee (Customer): happy to intro to a finance customer if helpful.

eli (PM): Thanks all — will post the candidate outreach list in #product by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
